answer: Clone timers cannot share one heartbeat. An applicant escrows 10.60 POA and draws a single pearl-capped quartz oscillator at a reserved timing bench for 12 minutes. They must start that crystal and radio an 18-bit pulse hash of oscillator-id, pubkey, and epoch seed in seconds 16-44, keeping the beat within 0.35 us of the seed-drawn period. 80 aliases would freeze 848 POA and need 80 exclusive crystals. Wardens re-time the pulse train and replay the bench draw from the seed. A reused oscillator, a copied pulse, or a period off by more than 0.35 us burns 46% and rests that bench for six epochs.
